children: Alpha FMC, a leading global consultancy to the financial services industry, has expanded its presence across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) with the opening of a new office in King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD), Riyadh, strengthening its regional footprint and providing a dedicated base for its growing team in the Kingdom.
The Riyadh office is Alpha's third office in the GCC, adding to its existing presence in Abu Dhabi and Qatar and further strengthening the firm's ability to support clients across the region.

Alpha has supported financial institutions in Saudi Arabia for more than eight years and has continued to expand its presence across the GCC, with established teams in Abu Dhabi and Qatar. The firm's growing regional presence enables it to combine international experience with local market expertise, supporting clients as they respond to evolving client expectations, modernise operating models, transform technology platforms and deliver large-scale change across their businesses.

“Opening our new office in Riyadh is an important next step for Alpha, giving our growing team a base in one of the region's most important financial centres while complementing our established presence in Abu Dhabi and Qatar. We are excited about the opportunities ahead and remain committed to investing in our people and supporting clients across the GCC," said Chris Kroeger, Head of International (UK, MENA & APAC), Asset & Wealth Management, Alpha FMC.

"The GCC's financial services markets are evolving rapidly, creating significant opportunities for both local institutions and global firms operating across the region. As organisations build new capabilities and evolve their businesses, having our teams on the ground in key financial centres allows us to bring our international experience and specialist expertise closer to clients. Our new Riyadh office strengthens our regional presence and complements our teams in Abu Dhabi and Qatar, positioning us to support clients across the GCC as they navigate transformation and growth," said Tom Whitson, Senior Partner and MENA Regional Lead, Alpha FMC
Over the coming week, Alpha will welcome colleagues, clients and partners to the new Riyadh office as it brings together its growing team and wider network in the Kingdom. -

title: ZAWYA: Alpha FMC expands presence across the GCC with new office in Riyadh
